target_customer: Large brand marketers and their agencies that want to measure the effect of brand advertising
problem: Marketers could not easily tell whether brand advertising worked. The company started with survey based data collection and grew into brand lift measurement, reach validation and optimization.
business_model: Enterprise SaaS subscription for brand measurement and analytics
product_category: Marketing analytics and brand lift measurement

founders.name: Chris Kelly
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as founder and CEO, and the company's 2020 rebrand post says the founders were two people at the start. The second founder is not named in sources I opened.

competitors.name: Google Consumer Surveys
competitors.what: Self serve consumer survey product that put survey questions on publisher sites, launched in March 2012

technical_complexity.rationale: Building a respondent network through publisher placements and later statistical measurement with data science was moderately hard for a small team. Sources do not describe the early product in detail.

defensibility.rationale: Panel reach and measurement methodology, with enterprise customers such as Unilever and Verizon, raise switching costs, but survey tools from Google and others were close substitutes at the start.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Google Surveys launched months before the batch. Upwave still grew, pivoted to brand analytics and in 2021 sold its legacy survey product Instant Insights to PureSpectrum.

market_need_then: Google launched a self serve consumer survey product in March 2012, which signalled demand for cheap online surveys. Specific spend or complaint data for Survata at founding was not found.

branding.name_origin: Survata was chosen quickly by two founders in an unfurnished apartment office with no customers and no product (company rebrand post). Upwave was chosen in 2020 to signal using data to lift brands, to feel startup like yet serious, and to sound forward looking.
branding.domain_note: Now upwave.com; earlier survata.com domain. Details not found.

rebrands.why: CEO Chris Kelly wrote that the original name underselling the platform as it grew from survey data collection into brand marketing measurement

branding.community_and_virality: Trade press coverage of the rebrand and a Lexicon Branding case study page on the Upwave name. No evidence of consumer community.

brand_strength.rationale: A B2B brand known mostly by marketers. The founders themselves said the first name undersold the company, and they changed it in 2020.

pivots.to: Brand marketing measurement and analytics platform (Upwave)
pivots.why: Product grew from surveys into planning, measuring and optimizing brand marketing, per the rebrand post

outcome_analysis: Survata raised a 6 million dollar Series A in 2015 and a 14 million dollar Series B in 2018, then repositioned as Upwave in 2020 around brand measurement for large marketers and sold its legacy survey product in 2021. It remains independent and active with about 50 staff. The story is a slow but sustained move from survey tooling to enterprise analytics, helped by a pivot rather than a breakout.
notes: Series A 6 million dollars led by IDG Ventures with Bloomberg Beta comes from a TechCrunch report as relayed by a search summary and Seedtable (aggregator); the TechCrunch page itself was not opened. The Series B blog page shows a post date of April 1, 2022 but a search summary dates it July 2018; recorded as 2018-07 per aggregators and the post title. Other databases list a seed in 2013 and a 2020 debt financing, unverified. Total raised reports vary (ZoomInfo says 24.2 million, unverified). Whether the early product was a survey wall was not confirmed. PureSpectrum bought the Instant Insights product line in 2021, which is a product sale, not a company exit.
